coverage_notes: CMS Public Notices was checked first. Direct retrieval of both the current Public Notices page and the legacy Termination Notices URL failed in the web retrieval layer; an official CMS-domain search was therefore used as fallback and surfaced no new in-window provider termination, rescission, CLIA limitation/suspension, or similar access-risk notice.

Exactly 12 additional targeted web searches were run across hospital/ED, maternity, behavioral health, dialysis, oncology, primary care, rural/emergency service loss, ambulance, air-medical, restoration/reopening, U.S. territories, and broad hospital service suspension miss classes.

No new qualifying U.S. or territory healthcare-access change was identified in the bounded window. Results outside the hourly window, non-U.S. events, proposals without a concrete access effect, business/expansion items without service loss, and duplicates or already-existing service changes were excluded.
